title: Count AI detector 'unavailable' outcomes on the retry-exhausted path, not in the retried activity
answers: why does the ai detector unavailable metric show several failures for one alert check
retried check counted as both failure and success
how to count failed alert checks with Temporal retries
body:
Symptom: `posthog_insight_alerts_ai_detector_checks_total{outcome="unavailable"}` grows several times per scheduled check, and a check that failed once then succeeded on retry shows up as both a failure and a success.
Root cause: posthog/temporal/alerts/activities.py:evaluate_alert called `record_ai_detector_check_outcome("unavailable")` before re-raising `LLMDetectorUnavailableError`. Temporal retries that activity, so the counter went up once per attempt.
Fix pattern: evaluate_alert just re-raises. posthog/temporal/alerts/activities.py:record_failed_evaluation increments `unavailable` only after `_write_errored_alert_check` has actually written a check and `error.get("code") == LLM_DETECTOR_UNAVAILABLE_ERROR_CODE`.
Constraints: any per-check health metric for a Temporal activity with a retry policy belongs on the terminal path (retry-exhausted, or the final success), never on a failing attempt. Early returns in record_failed_evaluation (disabled alert, next_check_at already in the future, alert deleted) write no check, so they must not count either. Tests in posthog/temporal/tests/test_alerts_activities.py (TestRecordFailedEvaluation, TestEvaluateAlert) pin this behaviour.
applies: Alert check metrics and outcome counters emitted from Temporal alert activities
